title: What About The Other People
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2026-02-02

Opens [Prov 30](/bible/proverbs/30) · [Deut 32](/bible/deuteronomy/32) · [Dan 7](/bible/daniel/7) · [Ps 148](/bible/psalms/148) · [Rev 21](/bible/revelation/21) · [2 Esdras 6](/bible/2-esdras/6) · [Isa 44](/bible/isaiah/44) · [Luke 21](/bible/luke/21) · [Isa 40](/bible/isaiah/40) · [Esth (Gk) 14](/bible/esther-greek/14) · [Exod 11](/bible/exodus/11) · [Matt 15](/bible/matthew/15) · [Mark 7](/bible/mark/7) · [Jer 30](/bible/jeremiah/30) · [Rev 2](/bible/revelation/2) · [Lev 25](/bible/leviticus/25)
## Introduction *[[0:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=13s)]* Hey, shalom. Shalom Israel. Most high Christ blessed. Welcome to another edition of 15 minutes with the captains. My name is Captain Benaiah, IUIC Tupelo. And today's topic is what about the other people? You know the scripture says that everything is given to Israel. The kingdom is for the nation of Israel. So the question we often get is what about the other people? A lot of people try to add to the word to include their mama, their daddy, their cousin, everybody. But we're going to give you straight scripture and see what about the other people. ## Scriptures Opened **[Proverbs 30:6](/bible/proverbs/30#v6)** *[[1:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=64s)]* > [6](/bible/proverbs/30#v6) Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar. - Add thou not unto his words: the scriptures say we cannot add to the word. You can't add to the word to make you feel good, to fit your mama them in. To fit your granddaddy in. No, you got to go by the scripture. - Lest he reprove thee: you hear that? God is going to reprove you. - And thou be found a liar: and just like a lot of pastors today, when we go into the Bible and break down the scriptures, a lot of pastors are found liars. So we can't add to the word of God. As it is written, that's how we got to teach it. **[Deuteronomy 32:8-9](/bible/deuteronomy/32#v8)** *[[1:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=116s)]* > [8](/bible/deuteronomy/32#v8) When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel. > > [9](/bible/deuteronomy/32#v9) For the Lord’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance. - So let's get into the scripture and see who gets God inheritance. - When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance: so when the Lord divided to the nations their inheritance. - When he separated the sons of Adam: and when he separated the sons of Adam. - For the Lord's portion is his people: the Lord's portion is his people. - Jacob is the lot of his inheritance: so Jacob is the father of the 12 tribes of Israel. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance. Meaning Jacob gets the Lord inheritance. He hadn't been secret about that. He said that throughout the whole scripture, that Jacob is the lot of his inheritance. Guess what? The kingdom, everything goes to Jacob. Who is Jacob? The 12 tribes of the children of Israel. **[Daniel 7:18](/bible/daniel/7#v18)** *[[3:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=194s)]* > [18](/bible/daniel/7#v18) But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever. - The Lord has always repeated that the kingdom is for the 12 tribes of the children of Israel. - But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom: so the saints of the most high going to take the kingdom. Now let's get the precept for saints so we'll know who the saints are. **[Psalms 148:14](/bible/psalms/148#v14)** *[[3:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=224s)]* > [14](/bible/psalms/148#v14) He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord. - The praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel: even the children of Israel. So who are the saints? The children of Israel. So according to Daniel 7 and 18, it matches up with Deuteronomy chapter 32. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance. The saints are the Israelites. They're going to get the kingdom. **[Daniel 7:18](/bible/daniel/7#v18)** *[[4:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=263s)]* > [18](/bible/daniel/7#v18) But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever. - But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom: so the saints of the most high are going to take the kingdom. - And possess the kingdom for ever: oh. So the saints of the most high are going to take the kingdom, possess the kingdom forever. It don't say all nations right there. It says the saints of the most high. **[Daniel 7:27](/bible/daniel/7#v27)** *[[4:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=284s)]* > [27](/bible/daniel/7#v27) And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him. - Shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High: oh, so the scriptures say the kingdom and the greatness of the kingdom and the dominion of the kingdom shall be given to the people of the saints of the most high. Who are the saints? Psalms 148:14, the saints are the children of Israel. - Whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom: it ain't nothing after the saints' kingdom. - And all dominions shall serve and obey him: all dominions shall serve and obey Christ. Okay. All dominions shall serve and obey Christ. So the saints get the kingdom. **[Revelation 21:1](/bible/revelation/21#v1)** *[[5:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=331s)]* > [1](/bible/revelation/21#v1) And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea. - And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: you see that? A new heaven and a new earth. **[Revelation 21:12](/bible/revelation/21#v12)** *[[5:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=352s)]* > [12](/bible/revelation/21#v12) And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel: - And had a wall great and high: so the kingdom of heaven had a wall great and high. - And had twelve gates: and had 12 gates. - Which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel: ah, you see that? So the kingdom of heaven has 12 gates and names on the gates. Judah, Benjamin, Levi, Naphtali, and so on, are the 12 tribes of Israel. So who is the kingdom of heaven for? The 12 tribes of Israel. You can't squeak your grandma and them in. Mainly the people that they try to squeak in is the white man. That's what they try to do. That's what our people try to do. They set up whole church system to save the white man. But the scriptures say the 12 tribes of Israel shall inherit the kingdom. Now I know what you're thinking. Well, what about the other people? **[2 Esdras 6:53-54](/bible/2-esdras/6#v53)** *[[6:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=411s)]* > [53](/bible/2-esdras/6#v53) Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth, that before thee it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things: > > [54](/bible/2-esdras/6#v54) And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen. - Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth, that before thee it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things: so upon the sixth day, the Lord made beasts, cattle, and creeping things. - And after these, Adam also: so Adam also on the sixth day. - Of him come we all: so we all come out of Adam. - And the people also whom thou hast chosen: and the people who the Lord had chose come out of Adam. Who is the people that the Lord have chose? Because the Christian church say everybody is chosen. No, no, no, no. The Israelites are chosen. **[Isaiah 44:1](/bible/isaiah/44#v1)** *[[7:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=471s)]* > [1](/bible/isaiah/44#v1) Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen: - And Israel, whom I have chosen: ah, see that? Israel is the chosen, the nation of Israel. Not the land, the people, the 12 tribes of Israel. They are the chosen people. And no, the people that's in the land today are not the 12 tribes of Israel. The people that are in the land today are Gentiles. Thus said the Lord. **[Luke 21:24](/bible/luke/21#v24)** *[[8:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=501s)]* > [24](/bible/luke/21#v24) And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. - So the true Israelites have been cast out of the land for sin. So the land has been inherited by the Gentiles until their time has been fulfilled. - And they shall fall by the edge of the sword: so the 12 tribes of Israel fell by the edge of the sword. - And shall be led away captive into all nations: so the real 12 tribes have been led away captive into all nations. - And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles: so Jerusalem is being trodden down of the Gentiles right now. - Until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled: until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. So who is in the land right now? Gentiles. **[2 Esdras 6:53-56](/bible/2-esdras/6#v53)** *[[9:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=555s)]* > [53](/bible/2-esdras/6#v53) Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth, that before thee it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things: > > [54](/bible/2-esdras/6#v54) And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen. > > [55](/bible/2-esdras/6#v55) All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes > > [56](/bible/2-esdras/6#v56) As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing, but be like unto spittle: and hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel. - We're still dealing with the other people. What about the other people? - Of him come we all: we all come from Adam. - Because thou madest the world for our sakes: so according to the prophet Ezra, the world was made for the 12 tribes of Israel's sakes. - As for the other people: ah, now, now let's get the answer to the question. As for the other people. - Thou hast said that they are nothing: oh, so the Lord said that the other nations are nothing. That's what the Lord says. That's what God said. Thus said the Lord. - But be like unto spittle: oh, the Lord said they like unto spittle. You know what spittle is, right? That's what the Lord says. Thus said the Lord. - And hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel: so according to the prophet Ezra, the other nations are nothing according to the Bible. Nothing. God don't care about the other nation. He only cares about the nation of Israel, the 12 tribes of Israel. **[Isaiah 40:15-16](/bible/isaiah/40#v15)** *[[10:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=652s)]* > [15](/bible/isaiah/40#v15) Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing. > > [16](/bible/isaiah/40#v16) And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering. - Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket: oh, the prophet Isaiah saying the same thing the prophet Ezra said. The nations are as a drop in a bucket. - And are counted as the small dust of the balance: you see that? The nations are like small dust on a scale. You're not going to clean the dust off the scale before you weigh something because it's nothing. - Nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering: the Lord said you can't even burn all the trees in Lebanon and sacrifice all the beasts for these other nations. Lord is never going to accept the other nations according to the Bible. **[Esther (Greek) 14:10-11](/bible/esther-greek/14#v10)** *[[12:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=754s)]* > [10](/bible/esther-greek/14#v10) And open the mouths of the heathen to set forth the praises of the idols, and to magnify a fleshly king for ever. > > [11](/bible/esther-greek/14#v11) O Lord, give not thy sceptre unto them that be nothing, and let them not laugh at our fall; but turn their device upon themselves, and make him an example, that hath begun this against us. - Esther the foremother had a prayer before she went in. When you read the history, she was going into the king to ask, because a bounty was put on the Israelites' head. So she was using her queenship, is queenship a word, in order to save her people. - And open the mouths of the heathen to set forth the praises of the idols: so we going into her prayer here. - And to magnify a fleshly king for ever: so Esther is saying, look, these heathen, the other nations that are nothing, are praising idols. They praise idols. We don't praise idols. We praise the God of Israel. - O Lord, give not thy sceptre unto them that be nothing: ah, you hear what Esther say? Don't give your scepter to them that be nothing. Who is them that be nothing? The other nations. The foremother Esther said the same thing that the prophet Ezra said, and the prophet Isaiah. The other nations are nothing. Matter of fact, the other nations are called dogs as well. **[Exodus 11:7](/bible/exodus/11#v7)** *[[13:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=820s)]* > [7](/bible/exodus/11#v7) But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel. - So according to the Bible, the other nations are nothing. - Shall not a dog move his tongue: that ain't talking about a roof roof dog. That's talking about the Egyptians. - Against man or beast: you're not going to move your mouth against the Israelites, men or their beast. - That ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel: you see that? The Lord put a difference between the Egyptians and the Israel. Who was the children? Who was the dog? The Israelites are the children. The dogs were the Egyptians. And they were black people. So all black people ain't the same. The Israelites were different from the Egyptians. The Israelites are God's chosen people. The Egyptians are dogs. **[Matthew 15:21-22](/bible/matthew/15#v21)** *[[14:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=890s)]* > [21](/bible/matthew/15#v21) Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon. > > [22](/bible/matthew/15#v22) And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil. - Now let's go to the New Testament. Did Christ say that? He said the same thing about the other nations. Same thing. Old Testament, New Testament. The other nations ain't nothing according to the Bible. - And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts: so this woman was not an Israelite. I'm going to prove it. **[Mark 7:24-26](/bible/mark/7#v24)** *[[15:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=922s)]* > [24](/bible/mark/7#v24) And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid. > > [25](/bible/mark/7#v25) For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet: > > [26](/bible/mark/7#v26) The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter. - For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him: so this woman heard that Christ was in town and her daughter had an unclean spirit. So she sought after Christ. - The woman was a Greek: the woman was a Greek. She was an Edomite. - And she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter: she was not an Israelite, brother. **[Matthew 15:22-26](/bible/matthew/15#v22)** *[[16:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=968s)]* > [22](/bible/matthew/15#v22) And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil. > > [23](/bible/matthew/15#v23) But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us. > > [24](/bible/matthew/15#v24) But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. > > [25](/bible/matthew/15#v25) Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me. > > [26](/bible/matthew/15#v26) But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs. - I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel: ah, you see that? Christ said, "I'm only sent to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. I'm not sent to no other nations. I'm not sent to any other nation." Guess what? Because the other nations never got the covenant. They never got no covenant. Why would Christ go to them? They never had the covenant. The scripture say don't add to the word. - It is not meet to take the children's bread: you see that? He said it ain't meet to take the children's bread. - And to cast it to dogs: and cast it to a dog. So get what Christ called this woman. She was not an Israelite. She was a dog. Just like the Egyptians were dogs. Just like all the other nations according to the scriptures are nothing. **[Jeremiah 30:16](/bible/jeremiah/30#v16)** *[[17:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=1050s)]* > [16](/bible/jeremiah/30#v16) Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey. - Now let's get the end of all the nations. Now, did the Lord use the other nations to punish us? Yes, he used the other nations to punish the Israelites for their disobedience to God law. But it was always prophesized that the Lord was going to bring Israel back, and they were going to inherit the kingdom. - Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured: all the people that devoured the Israelites, meaning had us in slavery, raped, robbed, and murdered us, took our minerals, took our natural resources as they do to this very day. - And all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity: thus said the Lord, the scripture say every one of them going to go into captivity to the Israelites. **[Revelation 2:26](/bible/revelation/2#v26)** *[[18:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=1110s)]* > [26](/bible/revelation/2#v26) And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations: - If the Israelites repent, the Israelites come back, repent, and keep the commandments to the end. This is what the scriptures say. - And he that overcometh: and he that overcome his sins of the nation of Israel. - And keepeth my works unto the end: and keep the commandments to the end. - To him will I give power over the nations: you see that? Christ say he's going to give us power over the nations as we repent, keep the commandments to the end. **[Jeremiah 30:11](/bible/jeremiah/30#v11)** *[[19:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=1150s)]* > [11](/bible/jeremiah/30#v11) For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished. - Let's see the total end of the other nations. What's the final fate of all of the other people on the earth? - For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: you see that? The Lord has always prophesied he's going to save the nation of Israel. No other nation. - Though I make a full end of all nations: he's going to make a full end of all the nations. Meaning what? All other nations going to eventually be wiped out. Thus sayeth the Lord. - Yet will I not make a full end of thee: you see that? The scripture say he's not going to make a full end of all Israel, because Israel is the Lord's portion. They are going to get the kingdom. But as for the other people, they were made to be servants to the Israelites. That's what they were created for. **[Leviticus 25:44-46](/bible/leviticus/25#v44)** *[[20:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=1210s)]* > [44](/bible/leviticus/25#v44) Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids. > > [45](/bible/leviticus/25#v45) Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession. > > [46](/bible/leviticus/25#v46) And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour. - Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen: oh, you see that? The bondman and the bondmaids shall be of the heathen. - Of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids: of them shall ye buy. The Israelites were to buy the heathen. But because we didn't keep the commandments of God, the tithes turned on us. But it's going to go right back. The end of the whole matter is that the Israelites are going to get the kingdom. - And they shall be your possession: you see that? They shall be our possessions. That's what the scriptures say. - They shall be your bondmen for ever: ah, you see that? The other nations supposed to been the Israelites' bondmen forever. That's what the Lord made them for. But when we didn't keep the commandments of God, it was turned on us. But that's all right. According to the prophecies, the Israelites are going to inherit the kingdom, and the other nations going to be their slaves, when you read in Isaiah chapter 14. But the total end is the other nations are going to be totally wiped out. ## In Closing *[[22:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8&t=1322s)]* So that has been another 15 minutes with the captains. You want to know what's going to happen to the other nations? There you go. And with that, Israel, we going to say, hey, shalom. --- [15 Minutes Index](/captains) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ZMdcI2xVl8)
